MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The smart plug feels like a useful next step after my recent Echo purchases because it adds voice control for a household device instead of repeating a function I already have.",
    "The Alexa speakers and displays connect with my recent interests, and the Dot with a clock offers a feature I find appealing even though I would skip another Dot now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Show 8 stand does not fit the Show 5 I recently interacted with; sharing the Echo name does not make the accessory useful to me.",
    "The first-generation Show 5 offers little appeal after my second-generation Show 5 interaction, and another display is a lower priority right now.",
    "The Echo Auto mount assumes I have a device my history does not establish, while my old GPS interaction does not imply a current interest in Alexa for my car.",
    "Security is relevant to my past alarm interest, but a three-camera pack is more than I would choose now; the larger Show's auto-renewing trial also makes that particular bundle less appealing."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My recent Alexa interest seems to have been stretched into interest in almost any Echo product, even when it duplicates something I recently chose.",
    "My interest in a stand seems to have been treated as interest in stands generally, although the exact device it fits is what matters."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent Show 5 and matching stand interactions suggest I am equipping that device, which makes compatible additions more useful than accessories for a different display.",
    "I distinguish between something that fits my interests and something I need next: adding household control appeals more now than another speaker or screen.",
    "The particular generation, pack size, and included subscription affect my choice even when the basic product sounds relevant."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my recent Alexa interest but missed that I currently favor useful, compatible additions over duplicate devices or loosely related accessories."
}
